summary.en: Show each phone once and fall back to a controllable MJPEG picture when its H264 stream is unusable.
summary.zh: 每台手机只展示一次，并在 H264 画面不可用时回退到可控制的 MJPEG 画面。

compatibilityExceptions.reason: Device deduplication, capture fallback, and the connected phone view run in the Desktop Host and Web client; they do not change Mobile source, build inputs, or artifacts.
The local phone listing and capture path do not change Platform services, deployment inputs, or wire formats.
